title: The Shepherd and the Lion
summary: A shepherd extracted a thorn from a roaring lion's paw. Condemned to the arena years later, the beast recognized him and defended his deliverer....
full_text: A shepherd extracted a thorn from a roaring lion's paw. Condemned to the arena years later, the beast recognized him and defended his deliverer.
moral: Compassion to the suffering beast creates an unbreakable bond.
